# Dental Member Network

> A membership network for US dental practice owners that pairs an
> expert helpline with a partner-discount catalog, a curated kit
> library of proven playbooks, and a Book Club track. Each member
> problem gets a written action plan from a real human within 2–3
> business days.

## What it is

- Membership-based, not lead-gen. Members pay $49/month (founding) or
  $199/month (standard) for ongoing access — no upsell into a coaching
  contract.
- The helpline is the differentiator: bring any practice problem in
  plain English, get a written action plan + recommended experts
  within 2–3 business days.
- Partner discounts average $6,400/year in net savings for active
  members.
- A growing resource library of expert kits across Practice
  Management, Front Desk, Team & Culture, Patient Experience and
  Billing & Collections, plus a Book Club track (Atomic Habits, Good
  to Great, The 7 Habits, and more).

## For whom

- **Members** — Owners and decision-makers in US dental practices
  (solo, group, DSO-curious). Best fit: practices with $1M–$5M revenue
  doing 1–4 chairs who want to reduce reliance on PPO networks and
  improve case acceptance.
- **Experts** — Coaches, consultants, and specialists who want to
  reach an engaged network of practice owners without running their
  own marketing funnel.
- **Partners** — Software, supplies, labs, equipment, marketing
  agencies, and training programs serving US dental practices.

## Pricing

- Founding member: $49/month or $490/year — first 100 only, then sold
  out. Rate locked while membership stays active.
- Standard member: $199/month or $1,990/year after founding sells out.
- 30-day money-back guarantee. Cancel anytime — no retention contract.
- Detailed pricing: https://dentalmembernetwork.com/pricing.md

## Blog — expert-written practice guidance

Practical, expert-led articles for dental practice owners and teams.
Each article is written with a named DMN expert and pairs with a full
implementation kit inside the membership.

- Blog index: https://dentalmembernetwork.com/blog
- How to Fill Open Hygiene Appointments Before They Become Lost
  Production (Gary Takacs — hygiene occupancy, pre-appointing, weekly
  huddle): https://dentalmembernetwork.com/blog/fill-open-hygiene-appointments
- How to Change Systems After Buying a Dental Practice Without Losing
  the Team or Patients (Ashley E. Boaz — phased transitions, team
  trust, early warning signals):
  https://dentalmembernetwork.com/blog/change-systems-after-buying-dental-practice
- Why Counting New Patients Can Hide a Broken Dental Case Acceptance
  System (James DeLuca — case acceptance measurement, Seven Doors
  framework):
  https://dentalmembernetwork.com/blog/why-counting-new-patients-can-hide-a-broken-case-acceptance-system
- Why New-Patient Calls Fail to Become Appointments (Gary Takacs —
  front-desk phone framework, seven discovery questions, two-option
  close):
  https://dentalmembernetwork.com/blog/new-patient-calls-to-appointments
- How to Improve Communication in Your Dental Practice (Monica Watson —
  expectations, handoffs, daily support question, safe honesty):
  https://dentalmembernetwork.com/blog/improve-dental-team-communication
- How to Prevent Dental Insurance Claim Denials Before They Happen
  (DeVon Banks — process-first billing workflow, denial log, patient
  collections):
  https://dentalmembernetwork.com/blog/prevent-dental-insurance-claim-denials

## Differentiators

- One-membership-is-the-product model — no funneling into $20K
  coaching contracts.
- Written action plans signed by a real human (not an AI bot).
- Partner discounts and resource kits curated by Gary Takacs
  (Thriving Dentist) and the founding team — not by algorithm.
- Book Club track: read alongside named principle videos, downloadable
  study guides and discussion prompts.
